about.tool: A broad-edged pen held at about 40°.
about.proportions: x-height 3 nib widths (the sheet's "3 becs de plume"); ascenders 1.6 x-heights, descenders 0.55; capitals about 1.45 x-heights tall and wider than tall.
about.features: A heavy cursive blackletter: hairline lead-ins, arches broken into a flat roof and a corner, a pointed almond o, a single-storey a, the d's back sweeping left over its bowl, f plunging below the line as a pointed stroke, descenders of g, h and y sweeping left; wide capitals of great curved strokes with curled hairline lead-ins and diamonds. The long s, the thin vertical hairlines inside C and E and the longest hairline flourishes are left out here.
about.history: The lettre bâtarde of the court of the Dukes of Burgundy, 15th century: the book hand of its great illuminated manuscripts (the scribes David Aubert and Jean Miélot).
